close_reason: Landed in a4c90d8. Added #[non_exhaustive] on both WrongLength and NonHexLowercase variants of Sha256DigestErrorKind with docstring rationale citing the related finding (.15) on adding the offending byte value. Internal tests unaffected (per-variant non_exhaustive only restricts external consumers). Workspace fmt/clippy/test all clean.
description:
crate-jmap-cid-types/src/digest.rs:28-48 declares:

    #[non_exhaustive]
    pub enum Sha256DigestErrorKind {
        WrongLength { got: usize },
        NonHexLowercase { at: usize },
    }

The #[non_exhaustive] attribute on the ENUM allows adding new variants without a breaking change, but does NOT propagate to the inline struct-like fields of existing variants. A downstream consumer can write:

    match err.kind {
        Sha256DigestErrorKind::WrongLength { got } => ...,
        Sha256DigestErrorKind::NonHexLowercase { at } => ...,
    }

…without a `..` wildcard, and the compiler will allow it. The day the maintainer wants to add a diagnostic-enrichment field — e.g. `expected_length` to `WrongLength`, or `byte: u8` to `NonHexLowercase` (see related finding on missing offending-byte value) — every match arm without `..` becomes a breaking change.

The fix is to add #[non_exhaustive] on each variant:

    #[non_exhaustive]
    pub enum Sha256DigestErrorKind {
        #[non_exhaustive]
        WrongLength { got: usize },
        #[non_exhaustive]
        NonHexLowercase { at: usize },
    }

Now external callers cannot match without `..`, and future field additions stay non-breaking. The cost is one extra `..` per match arm in caller code, which is a small upfront ergonomic cost for permanent semver-additive freedom on a diagnostic enum that is highly likely to grow fields.

Error enums are the canonical case for per-variant #[non_exhaustive] because they are precisely the types maintainers most often want to enrich post-1.0. Workspace-wide this is an under-applied pattern (grep for ^\s*#\[non_exhaustive\]\s*$ shows ~360 matches but none on variant-level for inline struct fields). Worth fixing here before v0.1.0 ships and consumers fossilize their match patterns; can be propagated as a workspace-canonical-templates sweep afterward.
title: Sha256DigestErrorKind variants missing per-variant #[non_exhaustive] — adding diagnostic fields is a breaking change
